---
title: "Survey research for NGOs and research organisations"
description: "Guidance for NGOs and research organisations: prepare a pre-analysis plan, connect it to the questionnaire, document analysis decisions and amendments, and report the completed study to stakeholders."
---

This page is for an NGO or research organisation planning its own survey
research. It keeps the questionnaire, the analysis decisions and the report
for stakeholders in 1 connected record.

## Your steps

1. **Set up.** Install R, RStudio and surveyframe as the
   [Get started](../start.html) page shows.
2. **Start from an example.** The [questionnaire templates](../templates.html)
   include customer satisfaction, employee engagement and decision-making
   studies to adapt.
3. **Prepare the pre-analysis plan.** Record each research question, the
   measurements and the method on the Plan screen, then export the plan from
   the Report screen. [The analysis plan](analysis-plan.html) explains each
   part.
4. **Collect responses your way.** The Collect screen gives you a survey web
   page to host, and an optional collector that stores each response in a
   Google Sheet your organisation owns.
5. **Document decisions.** A change to the plan after collection starts is
   recorded as an amendment with its reason.
6. **Report to stakeholders.** Export the APA 7 report as HTML, Word, PDF or
   OpenDocument. It presents the planned analyses, the results, your
   interpretation and the recorded amendments.
